Question: My sperm quality is not up to the mark as per medical report. shall i go for medical method like Invitro Fertilization to have child. In this method they use my spem and put in my wife overy after fertilization. Doctor is a women. Answer ID: 4705 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 521/521=M/1429) It is not right to use the abovementioned method for getting child, since it is unnatural and immodesty. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
